night3_start.name: {name}
night3_start.text: *Back in my room, I hang my bag over the chair.*

night3_start_2.name: {name}
night3_start_2.text: *I turn on the phone lying face down on my desk.*

night3_faithful_msg_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
night3_faithful_msg_seo_1.text: What you saw today stays between us.

night3_faithful_msg_seo_3.name: {name}
night3_faithful_msg_seo_3.text: *I read the message to the end and turn off the screen. The phone's glow disappears from the room.*

night3_faithful_msg_yuna_1.name: Yuna
night3_faithful_msg_yuna_1.text: *A short message arrives from Yuna about the notebook she lent me.*

night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2.name: Yuna
night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2.text: That novel, I still haven’t decided on the ending

night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2_b.name: {name}
night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2_b.text: *The cursor blinks on the last line of the note. A saved icon remains beside the filename.*

night3_faithful_msg_dain_1.name: Dain
night3_faithful_msg_dain_1.text: If you’re going to ask about my knee, come ask me in person lol

night3_faithful_msg_dain_3.name: {name}
night3_faithful_msg_dain_3.text: *There is a long gap between “lol” and the next sentence. No new message comes from Dain.*

night3_dream_1.name: {name}
night3_dream_1.text: *Before turning out the light, I pick up my phone once more. I remember footsteps beside mine today.*

night3_dream_2_b.name: {name}
night3_dream_2_b.text: *I put down my phone. I still don’t know what I’ll say tomorrow.*

night3_faithful_reflect_1.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_1.text: *Before sleeping, I open my phone’s gallery, scroll to Sojeong’s photo and hold it down.*

night3_faithful_reflect_2_b.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_2_b.text: *'Delete this photo?' My finger hovers over the confirm button.*

night3_faithful_reflect_2_c.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_2_c.text: *I stare at the screen for a moment, remembering the writing on Sojeong’s desk and the mornings I looked away.*

night3_faithful_reflect_2_d.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_2_d.text: *I tap Cancel. Deleting a photo would not change the choice I made.*

night3_faithful_reflect_3.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_3.text: *My finger stops over the delete button. Instead, I move the photo to a new folder named 'Record.'*

night3_faithful_reflect_3_b.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_3_b.text: *I leave a short note beside the photo. Nothing I say in a new chat can replace what I owe Sojeong.*

night3_faithful_reflect_4.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_4.text: *I open the new folder to check that the photo is still there. One image appears beneath its name.*

night3_dream_3.name: {name}
night3_dream_3.text: *I close the gallery and check tomorrow’s alarm. Even after putting the phone down, sleep takes a while.*

night3_dream_seo_bonus.name: {name}
night3_dream_seo_bonus.text: *When I close my eyes, the rooftop railing comes to mind first.*

night3_dream_yuna_bonus.name: {name}
night3_dream_yuna_bonus.text: *When I close my eyes, the library annex window comes to mind first.*

night3_dream_dain_bonus.name: {name}
night3_dream_dain_bonus.text: *When I close my eyes, I hear a ball bouncing on the gym floor.*

night3_cheat_msg_1.name: {name}
night3_cheat_msg_1.text: *The moment I return to my room, I turn on my phone.*

night3_cheat_msg_2.name: Seoyeon
night3_cheat_msg_2.text: Be that way only with me.

night3_cheat_msg_3_b.name: Seoyeon
night3_cheat_msg_3_b.text: *She types the word 'please.' The cursor sits after it for a long time.*

night3_cheat_msg_4_b.name: Yuna
night3_cheat_msg_4_b.text: *Neither I nor they want to be your backup.*

night3_cheat_msg_5.name: Yuna
night3_cheat_msg_5.text: *Decide who you're going to choose tomorrow.*

night3_cheat_msg_dain_1.name: Dain
night3_cheat_msg_dain_1.text: lol I wish this were a joke

night3_cheat_msg_7.name: Yuna
night3_cheat_msg_7.text: *I reread Yuna’s messages. My finger hovers over the reply field, then pulls away.*

night3_nightmare_1.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_1.text: *I lie down with the lights off, but sleep won't come. Only my phone screen glows against my palm.*

night3_nightmare_2_b.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_2_b.text: *I open Seoyeon's chat. Her last message is “Please.” Nothing new follows it.*

night3_nightmare_3.name: Seoyeon
night3_nightmare_3.text: I'm not asking you to answer now. Just don't avoid me tomorrow.

night3_nightmare_3_b.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_3_b.text: *Beneath Yuna’s messages, there’s only the read receipt.*

night3_nightmare_4.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_4.text: *Her last sentence is short: 'Don't avoid me. That's all.'*

night3_nightmare_4_b.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_4_b.text: *Dain’s only message starts with a laugh.*

night3_nightmare_5.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_5.text: *'I wish it had been a joke.' There are no new messages after that.*

night3_nightmare_6.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_6.text: *I open and close all three chats in turn. In each text box, I type a different first letter, then erase it.*

night3_nightmare_choice.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_choice.text: *Who will I be honest with first tomorrow?*
choices: Decide to talk to Seoyeon first
Decide to talk to Yuna first
Decide to talk to Dain first

night3_nightmare_seo.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_seo.text: *In Seoyeon's text box, I write, “I'll tell you face-to-face tomorrow,” and rest my thumb over Send.*

night3_nightmare_yuna.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_yuna.text: *In Yuna's text box, I write, “Tomorrow, I won't avoid you. I'll tell you,” and the cursor blinks after the final period.*

night3_nightmare_dain.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_dain.text: *I type, “Sorry I kept you waiting. I will talk to you tomorrow.” My thumb hovers over send in Dain’s chat.*

night3_nightmare_end.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_end.text: *One sentence remains in one text box. I close the other two chats. Nothing has been sent yet.*

night3_nightmare_end_3.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_end_3.text: *Still awake at three in the morning, I close the messages and open the gallery. I rest my thumb on Sojeong's photo.*

night3_cheat_reflect_2.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_2.text: *In the group photo, Sojeong is looking at the camera. Beside her, I'm looking somewhere else.*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_b.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_b.text: *I close the photo and return to my messages. The sentence I wrote earlier is still saved as a draft.*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_c.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_c.text: *I scan the chat list. A different message sits beside each of the three names.*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_d.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_d.text: *There’s a message from Minsu: ‘Putting it off won’t make it go away.’*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_e.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_e.text: *I read all three chats again from the top. I don't close any of them.*

night3_cheat_reflect_5.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_5.text: *I pull my hand away from Send and turn the phone face down. Three hours until my alarm.*

night3_end.name: {name}
night3_end.text: *I turn off the light and leave my phone face down.*

forced_violation_day3_after_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day3_after_seoyeon.text: *Even after the conversation ends, Seoyeon remains silent for a while. When she finally speaks again, her voice has gone cold.* Don't think you can pretend what you just did never happened. Don't come near me or contact me for a while.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day3_seoyeon_apologize.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day3_seoyeon_apologize.text: *Seoyeon's expression does not soften at the apology.* I heard you. That doesn't erase what happened. Like I said, don't contact me for a while.

forced_violation_day3_seoyeon_excuse.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day3_seoyeon_excuse.text: *Seoyeon cuts the explanation short.* A misunderstanding? The moment I said no, it stopped being one. Don't say anything else.

forced_violation_day3_after_yuna.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day3_after_yuna.text: *After the conversation breaks off, Yuna takes a short breath. Only caution remains on her tense face.* You knew I didn't want it, and you ignored me. I don't even want to see your face right now. Don't contact me again.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day3_yuna_apologize.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day3_yuna_apologize.text: *Yuna answers only after a long pause.* An apology doesn't make it disappear. Stop now.

forced_violation_day3_yuna_excuse.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day3_yuna_excuse.text: *Yuna cuts off the explanation before it is finished.* I said no. There's nothing to explain.

forced_violation_day3_after_dain.name: Dain
forced_violation_day3_after_dain.text: *Dain does not laugh it off the way she usually might. A long silence passes before she answers in a clipped, hard voice.* This isn't a joke. I said no and you forced it anyway. I'm not letting this go.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day3_dain_apologize.name: Dain
forced_violation_day3_dain_apologize.text: *Dain finally gives a short answer after a long pause.* Fine. Then we're done for today. I decide if and when we talk again.

forced_violation_day3_dain_excuse.name: Dain
forced_violation_day3_dain_excuse.text: *Dain's voice turns rough.* No. Don't make excuses. I said no, and you did it anyway.

forced_violation_day3_after_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day3_after_teacher.text: *After the conversation ends, the homeroom teacher makes the boundary even clearer, her voice firm.* What you just did clearly crossed a line. Do not come any closer. I will handle this through the proper procedures.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day3_teacher_apologize.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day3_teacher_apologize.text: *The homeroom teacher takes a short breath before continuing.* I heard your apology. I'll still follow the proper procedures. Don't say anything else.

forced_violation_day3_teacher_excuse.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day3_teacher_excuse.text: *The homeroom teacher cuts off the explanation.* This is not the time to start explaining yourself. Stop talking and keep your distance.

forced_violation_day3_after_haeun.name: Haeun
forced_violation_day3_after_haeun.text: *Haeun steps back and grips her student-council bracelet.* Don't come any closer. I'm calling a teacher now.
choices: Admit the wrongdoing and keep my distance.

forced_violation_day3_haeun_apologize.name: Haeun
forced_violation_day3_haeun_apologize.text: *Haeun backs toward the faculty office without answering. She keeps watching until she is sure you aren't following.*

forced_violation_day3_haeun_excuse.name: Haeun
forced_violation_day3_haeun_excuse.text: It wasn't a misunderstanding. Don't follow me. *Keeping her distance, Haeun opens the faculty-office door.*

forced_violation_day3_after_nurse.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day3_after_nurse.text: *As the conversation cuts off, all the usual playfulness leaves the school nurse's voice.* Keep your distance from now on. I will document what happened and inform the people who need to know.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day3_nurse_apologize.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day3_nurse_apologize.text: *The school nurse is silent for a moment, then answers firmly.* I hear your apology. I'll still document this and notify the appropriate people. This conversation is over.

forced_violation_day3_nurse_excuse.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day3_nurse_excuse.text: *The school nurse's voice drops lower.* Do you think calling it a misunderstanding changes anything? The fact is, you ignored me when I said no.
